name: Export fbx
explanation: Exports a model to the fbx (binary) format. Current exported material model is 3ds max physical material.

exposed_options.name: Texture Map Format
exposed_options.description: Format for exported texture maps. Default is auto = jpg + png for alpha textures.
exposed_options.description_long: Format for exported texture maps. Default is auto = jpg + png for alpha textures.

exposed_options.name: Normal Map Format
exposed_options.description: Format for exported normal maps. Default is auto = jpg + png for alpha textures.
exposed_options.description_long: Format for exported normal maps. Default is auto = jpg + png for alpha textures.

exposed_options.name: Texture Resolution
exposed_options.description: Resolution for exported texture maps. Default is 4096x4096.
exposed_options.description_long: Resolution for exported texture maps. Default is 4096x4096.

exposed_options.name: FBX Flip Normal Maps
exposed_options.description: Flip FBX normalmaps Y axis on export (DirectX vs OpenGL).
exposed_options.description_long: Flip FBX normalmaps Y axis on export (DirectX vs OpenGL).

exposed_options.name: Export binary format
exposed_options.description: Exports in binary fbx format (default). Otherwise exports fbx in ASCII format.
exposed_options.description_long: Exports in binary fbx format (default). Otherwise exports fbx in ASCII format.
